Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

The Data Science department plays a pivotal role in our company, generating value to Riskified by developing algorithms and analytical production-grade solutions. We leverage advanced techniques and algorithms to provide maximum value from data in all shapes and sizes (such as classification models, NLP, anomaly detection, graph theory, deep learning, and more). As a Data Scientist, you will assume the classic data-science role of an end-to-end project development and implementation practitioner. Being part of the team requires a mix of hard quantitative and analytical skills, solid background in statistical modeling and machine learning, a technical data-savvy nature, along with a passion for problem-solving and a desire to drive data-driven decision-making.


 

What You'll Be Doing
Data Exploration and Preprocessing: Collect, clean, and transform large, complex data sets from various sources to ensure data quality and integrity for analysis
Statistical Analysis and Modeling: Apply statistical methods and mathematical models to identify patterns, trends, and relationships in data sets, and develop predictive models
Machine Learning: Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, such as classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning, to solve business problems and improve processes
Feature Engineering: Extract relevant features from structured and unstructured data sources, and design and engineer new features to enhance model performance
Model Development and Evaluation: Build, train, and optimize machine learning models using state-of-the-art techniques, and evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics
Data Visualization: Present complex analysis results in a clear and concise manner using data visualization techniques, and communicate insights to stakeholders effectively
Collaborative Problem-Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders to identify data-driven solutions and implement them in production environments
Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and related fields, and proactively explore new approaches to enhance the company's analytical capabilities

 

Qualifications
B.Sc (M.Sc is a plus) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
3+ years of proven experience designing and implementing machine learning algorithms and successfully deploying them to production.
Strong understanding and practical experience with various machine learning algorithms.
Proficiency in Python, Experience with SQL and data manipulation tools (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) to extract, clean, and transform data for analysis
Solid foundation in statistical concepts and techniques, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, and experimental design
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach business problems, formulate hypotheses, and translate them into actionable solutions

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Why Qogita

Wholesale is a $50 trillion market still working the way it did in 1950. 90% of transactions happen offline, over calls, catalogues and trade shows, and a product passes through four or five layers of distributors and wholesalers before it reaches a store, with every party deciding on a fraction of the picture. By the time it hits the shelf, it costs roughly 40% more than the maker charged. That inefficiency tax runs into the trillions, and everyone pays it every time they buy anything.

Qogita is building the operating system that replaces that chain: a single order book connecting the global market, the rails to move goods across borders, and a self-learning system that does every job once, against real-time data about the whole market. That puts data science at the core of the product. Forecasting reads what is actually selling in every market as it sells, a buyer's basket is assembled from every available seller and split across the optimal combination, and every trade writes a record that sharpens the next price, allocation and route. It is a hard problem, spanning physical goods, thirty national regimes in Europe alone and buyers who are increasingly agents, and it is already working: 95% of transactions involve no human touch, and the business is doubling every year.

The role

You're a data scientist with strong quantitative and ML chops who can move between classical modelling, experimentation, and modern applied ML (including LLMs where they're the right tool). You'll own end-to-end data science work across Qogita's wholesale marketplace: framing ambiguous commercial problems, building models that ship, and keeping them healthy in production. The Data Science team partners with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial to build the intelligence layer behind pricing, matching, demand, and product discovery.

What You'll Do


Build and deliver data science solutions across the stack: predictive models, ranking, demand forecasting, segmentation, pricing, experimentation, and LLM-powered features, depending on where the business need is greatest
Take ownership of business-critical ML systems end-to-end: problem framing, model design, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance in production
Translate ambiguous business problems into tractable ML or statistical problems with clear success criteria, working closely with Product and Commercial
Apply quantitative methods (regression, causal inference, classical ML, and deep learning where useful) to pricing, demand, liquidity, supplier matching, catalogue enrichment, and related marketplace problems
Design and analyse experiments and A/B tests, owning statistical validity and turning results into recommendations teams can act on
Collaborate with Engineers to ship models via reproducible MLOps workflows: experiment tracking, model serving, alerting, and production monitoring
Communicate model choices, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders


What You'll Bring


3+ years as a data scientist, applied ML engineer, or quantitative analyst, with meaningful exposure across ML methods and statistical modelling
A track record of owning models in production, not just building them: maintaining, monitoring, and iterating as live infrastructure
Solid grounding in ML and stats fundamentals: probability, supervised and unsupervised learning, and measurement/validation discipline
Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large transactional datasets and common DS/ML libraries (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or similar)
Experience collaborating on MLOps-style workflows (experiment tracking, serving, monitoring) and shipping with engineers
Able to communicate uncertainty and model limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, CS, or related), or equivalent experience


Nice to have (depth in one or more)


Pricing and market economics: price theory, buyer behaviour, demand estimation, causal inference, experimentation with real commercial stakes
Production LLM systems: RAG, evaluation frameworks, prompt/fine-tuning trade-offs, transformers and major model families, LangChain or similar
Marketplace or B2B dynamics; AWS/GCP/Azure ML infra; Airflow, Docker, dbt, Snowflake, Lightdash or similar


Perks & Benefits


Base salary: €60,000 to €90,000 (Amsterdam) / £60,000 to £90,000 (London) depending on experience
26 days of annual leave, plus 4 additional personal days
Company performance-based bonus
Attractive equity package
Pension contributions
Annual learning & development budget
Office-led culture with hybrid flexibility

Home-office setup package
Office socials and annual company-wide offsite


Who we are

Qogita [Ko-gi-ta] is a fast-growing European startup building the operating system for modern wholesale. Founded in early 2021, we now operate globally.

Why Qogita

Wholesale is a $50 trillion market still working the way it did in 1950. 90% of transactions happen offline, over calls, catalogues and trade shows, and a product passes through four or five layers of distributors and wholesalers before it reaches a store, with every party deciding on a fraction of the picture. By the time it hits the shelf, it costs roughly 40% more than the maker charged. That inefficiency tax runs into the trillions, and everyone pays it every time they buy anything.

Qogita is building the operating system that replaces that chain: a single order book connecting the global market, the rails to move goods across borders, and a self-learning system that does every job once, against real-time data about the whole market. That puts data science at the core of the product. Forecasting reads what is actually selling in every market as it sells, a buyer's basket is assembled from every available seller and split across the optimal combination, and every trade writes a record that sharpens the next price, allocation and route. It is a hard problem, spanning physical goods, thirty national regimes in Europe alone and buyers who are increasingly agents, and it is already working: 95% of transactions involve no human touch, and the business is doubling every year.

The role

You're a data scientist with strong quantitative and ML chops who can move between classical modelling, experimentation, and modern applied ML (including LLMs where they're the right tool). You'll own end-to-end data science work across Qogita's wholesale marketplace: framing ambiguous commercial problems, building models that ship, and keeping them healthy in production. The Data Science team partners with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial to build the intelligence layer behind pricing, matching, demand, and product discovery.

What You'll Do

  • Build and deliver data science solutions across the stack: predictive models, ranking, demand forecasting, segmentation, pricing, experimentation, and LLM-powered features, depending on where the business need is greatest
  • Take ownership of business-critical ML systems end-to-end: problem framing, model design, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance in production
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into tractable ML or statistical problems with clear success criteria, working closely with Product and Commercial
  • Apply quantitative methods (regression, causal inference, classical ML, and deep learning where useful) to pricing, demand, liquidity, supplier matching, catalogue enrichment, and related marketplace problems
  • Design and analyse experiments and A/B tests, owning statistical validity and turning results into recommendations teams can act on
  • Collaborate with Engineers to ship models via reproducible MLOps workflows: experiment tracking, model serving, alerting, and production monitoring
  • Communicate model choices, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years as a data scientist, applied ML engineer, or quantitative analyst, with meaningful exposure across ML methods and statistical modelling
  • A track record of owning models in production, not just building them: maintaining, monitoring, and iterating as live infrastructure
  • Solid grounding in ML and stats fundamentals: probability, supervised and unsupervised learning, and measurement/validation discipline
  • Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large transactional datasets and common DS/ML libraries (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or similar)
  • Experience collaborating on MLOps-style workflows (experiment tracking, serving, monitoring) and shipping with engineers
  • Able to communicate uncertainty and model limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, CS, or related), or equivalent experience

Nice to have (depth in one or more)

  • Pricing and market economics: price theory, buyer behaviour, demand estimation, causal inference, experimentation with real commercial stakes
  • Production LLM systems: RAG, evaluation frameworks, prompt/fine-tuning trade-offs, transformers and major model families, LangChain or similar
  • Marketplace or B2B dynamics; AWS/GCP/Azure ML infra; Airflow, Docker, dbt, Snowflake, Lightdash or similar

  • 26 days of annual leave, plus 4 additional personal days

  • Office socials and annual company-wide offsite

Qogita [Ko-gi-ta] is a fast-growing European startup building the operating system for modern wholesale. Founded in early 2021, we now operate globally.

Title: Data Scientist in high-tech scale-up
Description:
Now Hiring: Data Scientist in high-tech scale-up

Location: Delft, on-site




At Luo, we build machines that automate quality inspections of medicine. In many pharmaceutical environments, people still spend hours manually checking products for particles, cosmetic defects, and packaging integrity issues. It’s tedious, and humans make mistakes. Our machines do this job more accurately, faster, and more consistently.




The brains of our machines are the detection models: algorithms that decide in real time whether a product passes inspection. We’ve proven the technology works. Now we’re scaling, which means more clients, more applications, and higher accuracy. For that, we need someone who builds, improves, and pushes these models to the next level.




Our office is located at YES!Delft, surrounded by dozens of other tech start-ups and scale-ups, right next to TU Delft. Much of the work happens hands-on, with our machines, test setups, and the teams around them.




The Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys developing and optimizing machine learning models for real-world applications. Not just running models and reporting results, but understanding what has impact and executing what must be done to make it better. Most of the time, that is more than just re-training.

You’ll work on detection models for particle contamination, cosmetic defects, and closure integrity problems. You stay on top of the latest developments in the field, translate them into concrete improvements, and ensure our models meet the strict requirements of the pharmaceutical industry. You work closely with the Software, Quality Support, and Machine Vision teams, who support you as you grow in the role.




What you’ll work on

Staying up to date: Following the latest developments in detection models and AI, assessing what’s relevant for our custom models, and translating this into concrete research actions.
Building and improving detection models: Adapting existing models to new clients, improving detection, and qualifying model performance offline.
Orchestrating data strategy: Managing and executing dataset annotation for model training and defining which data needs to be available to build and improve the best detection models.




What we are looking for

Education: A bachelor’s (HBO) in data science, AI, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong ML foundation: You have hands-on experience with Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, gained at work or during your studies, graduation project, or internship.
Data analysis: You have a strong focus on analyzing image data, understanding patterns, and extracting meaningful insights to improve model performance. Experience with medical or industrial datasets is a plus.
Hands-on experience: You are comfortable owning the full pipeline, including data collection, annotation, and running experiments independently, or you’re eager to learn this quickly.
Analytical and communicative: You can explain complex findings clearly to non-technical people and know how to tailor your message to your audience.
Languages: Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required. Dutch language skills are considered a plus.
Eye for quality: You recognize that accuracy is critical in the pharmaceutical industry and understand the real-world impact of your models, especially when it comes to patient safety.
Direct and transparent: You communicate openly about challenges. If a model underperforms or data is insufficient, you raise your concerns early so we can solve them together.
Office-based work is required, allowing for fast communication and close collaboration with your team.
Dutch/EER working permit




What it’s like to work here

Real impact: Your models run in real machines at real client sites. When you improve something, you directly see the effect!
Flat structure, short lines: Good idea? Go for it. Our structure is simple to encourage involvement, creativity, and innovation.
Interesting challenges: Detection problems in the pharmaceutical industry are complex and demanding. You’ll work at the edge of technology, where quality standards are high.
A solid team: You work alongside engineering, operational, and commercial teams who all share the same goal. Cooperation and teamwork are key to building and delivering machines that actually work.




Ready to build detection models that make a difference? Send your CV and a short intro to jobs@luoautomation.com

Description:

Explorar, analisar e avaliar dados estruturados e não estruturados, internos ou externos, para antecipar necessidades de negócio e operacionais.

Title: Data Scientist - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams to develop impactful analytics solutions, optimize code, and solve real-world business problems across diverse industries.

You’ll grow as a technologist by contributing to cutting-edge projects, R&D, and global conferences while working alongside world-class talent in a dynamic, innovative environment.

In this role, you will partner with clients to understand their needs and develop impactful analytics solutions. You will translate business problems into analytical challenges, build models to solve them, and ensure they are evaluated with relevant metrics. You’ll also contribute to internal tools, participate in R&D projects, and have opportunities to attend and present at conferences like NIPS and ICML.

Your work will create real-world impact. By identifying patterns in data and delivering innovative solutions, you will help clients maintain their competitive advantage and transform their day-to-day operations. Your contributions will directly influence business outcomes and drive lasting improvements across industries.

You will be in Stockholm, and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world working on interdisciplinary projects that use math, statistics, and machine learning to derive insights from raw data. You will help global companies transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries such as healthcare, automotive, energy, and elite sports.

At McKinsey, you’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll develop a sought-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, tackle real-life challenges across diverse industries, and collaborate with inspiring multidisciplinary teams, gaining a holistic understanding of AI and its potential to drive transformation.

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelors, Masters or PhD level in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
Professional experience in applying machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with copious amounts of data
Programming experience (focus on machine learning): R and/or Python (must), SPSS, SAS, Ruby, Hadoop (valued)
Ability to prototype statistical analysis and modeling algorithms and apply these algorithms for data driven solutions to problems in new domains
Ability to independently own and drive model development, balancing demands and deadlines
Demonstrated aptitude for analytics
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Good presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to people from other fields
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels
Willingness to travel

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Somos una de las entidades financieras de referencia de crédito al consumo en el mercado español. Con 35 años de historia en nuestro país, hemos acompañado a más de dos millones y medio de clientes para hacer realidad sus proyectos. Estamos respaldados por el grupo Crédit Mutuel, el cuarto banco más importante en Francia, que nos proporciona el soporte financiero y tecnológico necesario para diseñar, vender y gestionar una amplia gama de productos de crédito al consumo, préstamos personales, tarjetas, líneas de crédito, soluciones de pago y seguros.




Estamos buscando para nuestras oficinas de Cornellà de Llobregat a un/a Data Scientist.




Entre tus funciones y responsabilidades:




Identificar nuevas tendencias y oportunidades de análisis, colaborando con diferentes partes del negocio para impulsar la agenda de análisis y ciencias de datos.
Transformar grandes conjuntos de datos complejos en ideas pragmáticas y factibles.
Llevar a cabo actividades de investigación, desarrollo, exploración y descubrimiento de datos y desarrollar prototipos, algoritmos y pruebas de concepto, utilizando la ciencia de datos líder y soluciones innovadoras.
Aplicar métodos analíticos, como el aprendizaje automático, el reconocimiento de patrones, los algoritmos de recomendación para resolver problemas comerciales y optimizar resultados.
Trabajar en el descubrimiento de datos que aporte valor y ayude a la toma de decisiones.
Colaborar con los equipos de ingeniería de datos para mejorar los datos como activo del negocio.
Crear conocimientos sobre las tecnologías y técnicas existentes y emergentes, según corresponda a la ciencia de los datos, y mantener un espíritu de aprendizaje.




Requisitos del puesto:




Grado en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingenierías, Física (o estudios comparables). Valoramos otras formaciones (ADE, Economía,…) si se complementa con un Máster en Data Science / Data Analytics.
Experiencia mínima de 1 año como Data Scientist realizando modelos estadísticos / machine learning.
Experiencia práctica con alguno de los paquetes estadísticos: SAS, Python (Sckit-Learning, Pandas, Numpy, VerticaPy) y/o R.
Idiomas: valorable inglés o francés.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




Incorporarte a una multinacional del sector financiero en pleno proceso de transformación.
Integrarte en un equipo dinámico formando parte de proyectos transversales.
Amplias posibilidades de desarrollo profesional.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido con 2 días de teletrabajo a la semana.
Un completo paquete de compensación que incluye: contrato estable, salario fijo, variable, tickets restaurant y otros beneficios sociales.




En Cofidis, somos un grupo inclusivo que cree en el valor de la diversidad. Nos comprometemos a considerar todas las candidaturas cualificadas sin distinción de origen, género, edad, orientación sexual o discapacidad. Fomentamos un entorno diverso e inclusivo, con espacios de trabajo accesibles y adaptados. Si necesitas alguna adaptación durante el proceso de selección o en la entrevista, háznoslo saber. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Playground Data


Stockholm
Hybrid


Senior Data Scientist

We usually respond within a week

Some data problems are neat and tidy. Ours usually aren't. They are messy, evolving, and tied to real decisions. We work closely with our clients to understand what actually needs to be solved and build from there.

At Playground, we help clients put their data to work, from the platforms underneath to the models and AI solutions on top. We are a collaborative team that values solid engineering and shared growth, and our people see their work through, from first idea to production.

What you'll actually do

You'll work closely with our clients on initiatives where data science has a direct impact on how they operate. This role suits a data scientist who wants to work full-stack and own things end to end: making sense of messy data, deciding what's worth solving, building the models and seeing it through to production. Many of our engagements start from scratch, so you'll often be shaping the solution from day one.

In Practice, You’ll


Connect data from disparate sources and dig into it to find anomalies, inconsistencies and quality issues.
Set up rule engines and validation logic that encode business rules and catch problems automatically.
Model complex domains into semantic models that capture how a client's organization actually works.
Build and train models, picking the right method for the problem.
Take your work all the way to production and keep improving it over time.
Contribute internally by mentoring colleagues, shaping how we work with data science, being part of presales and supporting Playground's continued growth.


You’ll never sit idle, there’s always something meaningful to build, improve, or untangle.

Who are you?

You've worked as a data scientist for several years and have delivered data solutions, analyses and models that people rely on. Python and SQL are part of your daily toolkit, and you've worked with at least one cloud or data platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake etc.).

You Would Probably Describe Yourself As Someone Who


Owns it end to end: You'd rather shape the problem yourself and take it all the way to production than wait for a ticket or hand it over halfway.
Has solid fundamentals: You know your statistics and data modeling well enough to pick the right method, and explain why.
Has an eye for data quality: Inconsistencies bug you, and you dig until you understand where they come from and how to stop them.
Is comfortable in a consultant role: You handle customer dialogue well, can contribute in presales, and help guide clients through difficult decisions.


As a person, you’re humble, genuinely curious about technology, and motivated, while knowing that asking for help is a strength, not a weakness. Friendly, curious, and playful.

You must be based in the Stockholm area and have a valid work permit for Sweden (no visa sponsorship or relocation).

Buzzword bingo: Python, SQL, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Data Modeling, Semantic Models, Rule Engines

Language requirement

You need to be fluent in Swedish and able to use it confidently in a professional environment. Swedish citizenship is required.

Why? Most of our collaborations and client projects are conducted in Swedish, and several of our clients have formal requirements for both Swedish citizenship and full professional fluency in the language.

Let's Play!

Applying to us is a breeze!


Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
Answer the choice-questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise)
Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us


Note

Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support.

For this role applicants must have a swedish citizenship

Welcome to Playground!

At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.

Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Pricing
Description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About The Role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our marketplace. You’ll join the Pricing & Quality team (a mix of data scientists and backend engineers) focused on curating offers to give customers the best value for money.

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

What You’ll Do


Drive pricing intelligence: design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers
Own projects end to end: from problem definition and metrics design, through data extraction and model implementation, to presenting results to business and product stakeholders.
Collaborate with data scientists and backend engineers to translate models into production-ready features
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of fee strategies or model changes.
Leverage statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights and inform critical tech, business and product decisions
Communicate your work clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.


About You


At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering
Impact-driven: You’ve contributed to data science projects that made a real impact on live, customer-facing products — not just in theory, but in production.
Comfortable with ambiguity: you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect
Strong grasp of machine learning and statistical concepts and know how to choose the right model for the problem and make it work in a production environment.
Practical expertise in experimentation design and analysis.
Proficient in Python and SQL, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment
Clear communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.
Experience in pricing, B2C marketplaces or revenue management is a strong plus.


Recruitment process


Call with one of our Tech recruiter (1h)
Technical screening (30 min)
Technical Interview (1h15)
Stakeholder interview (1h)
Meet your manager (30min)
Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:


A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.


At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Manejo de Git y buenas prácticas de desarrollo colaborativo.

Title: Data Scientist (H/F)
Description:
🚀 MP DATA recrute un(e) Data Scientist




Vous êtes passionné(e) par l'intelligence artificielle, le machine learning et les projets à fort impact ? Rejoignez MP DATA et participez au développement de solutions innovantes au service de nos clients.




Vos missions :




En tant que Data Scientist, vous serez amené(e) à :




Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning, Deep Learning et de modélisation mathématique.
Réaliser les analyses exploratoires (EDA), le prétraitement des données, la sélection de variables et la validation statistique.
Mettre en place des expérimentations reproductibles et comparer différentes approches.
Tester, documenter et industrialiser vos modèles.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, ML Engineering et les experts métier.
Présenter vos résultats et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la compréhension des modèles.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
HTML:
At Cesar S.p.A., the company managing the Acqua & Sapone and La Saponeria brands, we are building a new Data Science team to support a data-driven transformation journey across the organization.

Cesar S.p.A. has been a leader for more than 30 years in the beauty, home care and personal care sectors. Through the Acqua & Sapone and La Saponeria store brands, we operate more than 850 points of sale and are expanding across Italy and Spain.

The launch of our new loyalty programme, the implementation of the new MS Dynamics 365 ERP system and the growing availability of high-quality data are opening a particularly exciting phase: we want to turn insights, models and analytical solutions into concrete, measurable decisions that are closely connected to the business.

Posizione:

The role:

As Senior Data Scientist, you will work on high-impact strategic initiatives, contributing to the design and development of custom solutions across areas such as supply chain, demand forecasting, assortment, promotions, loyalty, pricing, geomarketing and store network expansion.

This is a true greenfield opportunity: many solutions will be built from scratch, with the goal of helping the business move beyond manual processes by bringing structure, automation and predictive capabilities into decision-making.

What you will do:

  • Work closely with business teams to understand problems, processes, available data and operational objectives;
  • Translate business needs into well-structured analytics and data science problems;
  • Develop models, analyses and data-driven tools that generate measurable business value;
  • Lead the iterative development of solutions, from experimentation through to user adoption;
  • Support business teams during testing, validation and integration of solutions into operational processes.

Requisiti:

What we are looking for:

  • At least 3 years of experience in data science;
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with cloud computing will be considered a plus;
  • Solid foundations in machine learning, statistics and key developments in AI;
  • Experience developing lightweight web applications with open-source frameworks such as Streamlit or Flask;
  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools;
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical, managerial and operational stakeholders;
  • Good professional command of English.

Experience with retail and transactional data will be considered particularly relevant.

Alternatively, a background in consulting or complex business environments will be valued, especially where you have developed the ability to understand business needs and turn them into concrete analytical solutions.

Altre informazioni:

Location and working model:

The role involves periodic travel to our Pescara office, indicatively at least one week per month, with frequency varying depending on the project pipeline and collaboration needs with business teams.

Contract and compensation:

We offer a permanent employment contract under the Italian CCNL DMO collective agreement.

Compensation Will Be Aligned With Experience And Skills.

Why join us:

  • You will join a Data Science team in its early stages, with the opportunity to contribute directly to methods, tools and priorities;
  • You will work on business-focused use cases with direct impact on a large and growing retail network;
  • You will have the opportunity to build solutions from scratch, combining technical expertise, analytical thinking and stakeholder engagement.

If you are interested in applying data science to real business problems, working closely with business teams and contributing to the data-driven transformation of a fast-evolving retail group, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Apply or share this opportunity with someone who may be interested.

Cesar S.p.A. promotes an inclusive working environment and values applications from people with different backgrounds, experiences and career paths.

Analyze and interpret large, complex datasets to generate actionable business insights.

Title: Senior Data Scientist — Berlin – Health Technology
Description:
Senior Data Scientist — Berlin – Health Technology




We are working with a Berlin based AI-native patient intelligence company, backed by leading European healthtech investors. Their platform captures something the life sciences industry has never been able to access at scale: the patient's own account of living with a chronic or rare condition.




About the role




This role puts you at the heart of how that data becomes intelligence.

Working closely with their Chief AI Officer, you'll take unstructured patient narratives, hundreds of data points per person, and turn them into the models, metrics, and evidence that our clients act on. The questions are genuinely open: how do you quantify a patient journey? What signals predict a treatment switch? Where does the data reveal unmet need no one has named yet?




It's a role with unusually short distance between analysis and impact. What you build ships into a live product, in front of global life science teams, and shapes decisions that reach patients with chronic conditions worldwide.




What you'll do




Analyze and model large, multi-modal patient datasets to surface insights on patient journeys and unmet needs
Partner with the Chief AI Officer to develop, validate, and scale the algorithms behind our Patient Journey Analytics Platform
Work with engineers and product managers to turn data insights into user-facing features
Design and implement pipelines for data cleaning, feature engineering, and predictive modeling
Communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, shaping how life science companies make decisions
Keep pace with state-of-the-art ML/AI methods and bring new ideas into our production stack




What you'll bring




3+ years' professional experience as a Data Scientist, ideally in healthtech, SaaS, or a related field
Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow or similar)
Strong SQL and experience with both structured and unstructured data
Solid grounding in statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Ability to run independently on complex problems while collaborating closely with product and engineering
Full professional fluency in English, written and spoken




If you are an experienced Data Scientist who wants to make a true impact with a positive mission, please get in touch.

🔹 Knowledge of applied statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis and probability distributions.

🔹 Experience with data modelling, governance and data quality.

🔹 Experience with data visualisation tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn or ggplot2.

🔹 Degree, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Economics, Business Administration, Data Science or a related discipline.

🔹 Professional/native Spanish.

🔹 Experience working autonomously on Statistics and Machine Learning projects.

🔹 Experience with Tableau.




🏢 Hybrid model - 2 days on site per week

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Plats

Stockholm , På plats

Upplägg

Heltid

Ansök senast

2026-11-24

I rollen som Data Scientist hos Consid i Stockholm får du möjlighet att utveckla både dina idéer och dig själv. Tillsammans med våra kunder arbetar du med avancerad analys, maskininlärning och AI för att lösa affärsutmaningar och skapa verkligt värde. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper och tror att du trivs med att arbeta kundnära där du får kombinera teknik, analys och verksamhetsförståelse. Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, analytisk och drivs av att hitta insikter i komplex data.

Inom Consids affärsområde Data, AI och Analys hjälper vi våra kunder att bli verkligt datadrivna genom moderna dataplattformar, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar. I Stockholm är vi idag över 30 specialister inom dataområdet och nationellt är vi 115 kollegor som samarbetar tätt över hela landet. Efterfrågan på vår kompetens fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu fler Data Scientists som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens AI- och analyslösningar tillsammans med oss.

Är detta något för dig?

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Din kompetens

Minst 4 års erfarenhet som Data Scientist eller inom avancerad analys

Erfarenhet av maskininlärning, statistisk modellering och prediktiv analys

Goda kunskaper i Python och relevanta bibliotek för data science

Erfarenhet av att bygga, utvärdera och produktionssätta modeller

Erfarenhet av molnplattformar såsom Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud

Förmåga att kommunicera resultat och insikter till både tekniska och affärsmässiga intressenter

Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

Meriterande

Erfarenhet av generativ AI och stora språkmodeller (LLM)

Erfarenhet av MLOps och modellförvaltning

Erfarenhet av Databricks, Microsoft Fabric eller liknande plattformar

Erfarenhet av konsultrollen och kundnära arbete

Erfarenhet av att omsätta data och AI till affärsvärde

Fördelar hos Consid

Centralt kontor

Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser.

Utvecklas

Hos oss finns möjlighet att testa det som du är intresserad av och utveckla din roll i den riktning du vill.

Fantastiska kollegor

Du får världens duktigaste, trevligaste och mest hjälpsamma kollegor.

Jobba med det senaste

Få stora möjligheter att arbeta med nya och moderna tekniker och arbetssätt.

Vi erbjuder

Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv.

Centralt kontor

Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser.

Utvecklas

Hos oss finns möjlighet att testa det som du är intresserad av och utveckla din roll i den riktning du vill.

Fantastiska kollegor

Du får världens duktigaste, trevligaste och mest hjälpsamma kollegor.

Jobba med det senaste

Få stora möjligheter att arbeta med nya och moderna tekniker och arbetssätt.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
En Hays estamos colaborando con una compañía referente del sector Retail, que apuesta por la innovación y el uso de los datos como elemento clave para mejorar la toma de decisiones y optimizar diferentes áreas de negocio.




Actualmente buscamos un perfil de Data Scientist para incorporarse a su equipo de Data, participando en proyectos de analítica avanzada y Machine Learning aplicados al entorno Retail.

Desarrollar y mantener modelos de Machine Learning orientados a diferentes necesidades de negocio.
Analizar, limpiar y transformar grandes volúmenes de datos.
Desarrollar modelos predictivos y soluciones de analítica avanzada.
Identificar patrones, tendencias e insights relevantes para el negocio.

Experiencia de aproximadamente 2 años como Data Scientist.

Experiencia trabajando con Python y SQL.

Experiencia en tratamiento, análisis y explotación de datos.

Salario competitivo, acorde con la experiencia aportada.
Posibilidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Pricing
Description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About The Role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our marketplace. You’ll join the Pricing & Quality team (a mix of data scientists and backend engineers) focused on curating offers to give customers the best value for money.

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

What You’ll Do


Drive pricing intelligence: design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers
Own projects end to end: from problem definition and metrics design, through data extraction and model implementation, to presenting results to business and product stakeholders.
Collaborate with data scientists and backend engineers to translate models into production-ready features
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of fee strategies or model changes.
Leverage statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights and inform critical tech, business and product decisions
Communicate your work clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.


About You


At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering
Impact-driven: You’ve contributed to data science projects that made a real impact on live, customer-facing products — not just in theory, but in production.
Comfortable with ambiguity: you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect
Strong grasp of machine learning and statistical concepts and know how to choose the right model for the problem and make it work in a production environment.
Practical expertise in experimentation design and analysis.
Proficient in Python and SQL, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment
Clear communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.
Experience in pricing, B2C marketplaces or revenue management is a strong plus.


Recruitment process


Call with one of our Tech recruiter (1h)
Technical screening (30 min)
Technical Interview (1h15)
Stakeholder interview (1h)
Meet your manager (30min)
Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:


A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.


At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more industry segments.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Job Description

We are seeking a Data Scientist to play a pivotal role in our growing EMAP Data Science team. This position is ideal for an accomplished professional passionate about advanced analytics, innovation, and delivering impactful solutions to clients.

Role Purpose

The primary goal of this role is to design, develop, and deliver innovative data science solutions that address complex business challenges and create measurable value for our clients. The successful candidate will combine expertise in programming, data engineering, statistical modelling, machine learning, and Generative AI to transform data into actionable insights and scalable solutions.

Working closely with clients and internal stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, strengthen strategic relationships, and develop analytical products and prototypes that support data-driven decision making and business growth. You will leverage large and diverse datasets, anticipate challenges, and deliver high-quality solutions that generate tangible impact.

Responsibilities


Evaluate and acquire new data assets
Develop new product prototypes
Provide sales support and consultancy
Analyze, and document large datasets
Apply machine learning, data mining, and text mining techniques to extract value from data
Validate model and score performance
Document and present modeling processes and outcomes
Design analytical solutions for internal and external clients to address business problems. Design and deliver scalable analytics and AI solutions for internal and external clients to solve complex business challenges.
Make independent decisions to develop new approaches and resolve uncertainty in complex scenarios
Establish best practices for applying Experian and client data to create insights
Define business assumptions for relevant solutions
Create materials for knowledge sharing and roundtable discussions
Lead programs to enhance client analytical solutions, data quality, model performance, and project timelines
Guide team efforts to identify solutions
Share expertise and improve departmental contributions
Provide mentoring within project teams
Advocate for analytics through publications and presentations
Proficiency in Python
Understanding of data structures and their applications in marketing, risk, and customer management
Familiarity with regression models, XGBoost, neural networks, SVM, and ensemble methods
3+ years of experience in defining scope and delivering customized analytics projects
Expertise in advanced algorithms to solve practical business problems


Qualifications


Statistics
Computer Science
Machine Learning
AI
Programming
Python


Additional Information

You will get:


Personal Development - career pathway for professional growth supported by learning and development programs and unlimited access to online educational training courses, learning materials and books.
Work environment - excellent work conditions with friendly environment, recognized team spirit, and fun and quality recreation time.
Social benefit package including food vouchers, health insurance, monthly flex allowance and internet coverage, Sharesave plan, Employee assistance program, and many other benefits!
Opportunity for Flexible working hours and Home Office.


Experian is an Equal opportunity employer. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

This is a hybrid remote/in-office role.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - (Hybrid)
Description:
Senior Data Scientist (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our team in Barcelona. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

You will have the opportunity to crunch massive datasets using the latest Big Data technologies as well as solve problems using state of the art AI algorithms. You will have the chance to debate and explore new ideas, approaches and technologies with your team to design and implement the best solutions. We follow the philosophy of using the right tool for the right job and are not afraid to explore the greenfield. You will be a key player in the organisation; designing and implementing advanced analytics and using machine learning to build AI powered solutions for almost every area in the business like online fraud detection, recommendation engines, user experience personalization, optimising the flight combinations we offer or the marketing campaigns we launch, and virtually every possible area subject to optimization in the business. Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Within the Data Science team, we are focussed on researching and building cutting-edge solutions to evolve better travel experiences for our customers, all by leveraging the information from over 30 million searches that we receive everyday! Due to this scale, we are able to have a wider and better selection of travel plans that are tailored to suit the traveller’s needs which is probably more than any other travel site.. Machine learning models in production make over 1.8 Billion predictions a day improving customer experience and helping drive better decisions in an ever changing environment. The team is constantly evolving the next generation of models using cutting edge algorithms and technology to improve our goals to drive value for our customers.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


20 million customers – 44 markets – 5 brands – 6.5M members in Prime
16.2 million bookings FY23 - More than 50,000 bookings per day - 100 million daily user searches
8 Billion ML predictions per day - Up to 1.8 billion daily AI predictions[e1]
1400 employees – More than 50 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're a leading travel tech company, revolutionising the travel booking experience through our consumer insight, innovative technology, market leadership, and Prime, the world's first travel subscription program.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Data Scientist in the Data Science team, you will be in charge of:


Work with multi-disciplinary teams and key stakeholders to drive value and growth for both our customers and business.
Take ownership of initiatives and ensure successful delivery from initiation to final outcome.
Provide transparency on initiatives to the team and stakeholders.
Influence and advice stakeholders on the best course of action.
Keep up-to-date on the advancements in the area of machine learning and AI.
Lead and mentor data scientists.
Act as an evangelist for machine learning and AI.
Adhere to company values, create and maintain a friendly working environment.



What you need to succeed:

Job Requirements

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or other quantitative fields);
5+ years of related experience as a Data Scientist, AI expert or Machine Learning engineer;
A solid understanding of relevant statistical, data processing and machine learning methods and their implementation using standard open source frameworks;
Experienced with building production ready machine learning solutions and MLOps;
Experienced Python developer. Other programming languages are a plus;
Experience with cloud platforms and scalable solutions;
Experience creating solutions powered by Generative AI, specially Large Language Models, and LLM frameworks like LangChain will be a plus;
Written and oral communication skills (in English).



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation.

Title: Data Scientist – Time Series Forecasting
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2-3 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida —escribe buen código y se maneja con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers—, que trabaja de forma autónoma: gestiona su propio tiempo, toma la iniciativa sin dirección constante y da visibilidad proactiva de su avance. Comunica resultados e implicaciones de negocio por sí mismo/a, sin necesidad de supervisión constante.




Imprescindibles:

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
Mentalidad de optimización y rendimiento: diseña con el rendimiento en mente y propone mejoras que impactan en métricas (tiempos de procesamiento, consumo de recursos).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).
Tecnologías de bases de datos en cloud (p. ej. AWS) y despliegue en infraestructura cloud de datos/analítica.
Contenedores y pipelines/microservicios (Docker, Kubernetes).
Herramientas de dashboarding (Dash, Tableau).




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 30.000 y 36.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Location: Amsterdam (hybrid) | Full-time

About Roamler

Roamler is a Dutch technology company that helps clients grow their business, improve end-customer experience, and reduce and flexibilise the cost of field operations. It combines actionable insights with the execution capabilities required to turn those insights into measurable results.

Roamler operates through two business units:


Roamler Retail provides in-store and out-of-home insights and execution for FMCG brands and retailers across Europe, enabling clients to increase sales volumes while optimising operational efficiency.
Roamler Tech delivers installation, maintenance, and repair services for large B2C service providers, improving customer experience while increasing the efficiency and flexibility of field execution.



With approximately 130 employees and a large network of flexible workers active across multiple European markets, Roamler supports clients including P&G, Friesland Campina, Unilever, and Eneco.

Founded in Amsterdam in 2011, Roamler is backed by Endeit Capital and Smartfin, and operates across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, United States, and Spain.

Where you sit

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our AI/ML platform team and drive our data science products together with our other senior data scientist. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

The Data Science department plays a pivotal role in our company, generating value to Riskified by developing algorithms and analytical production-grade solutions. We leverage advanced techniques and algorithms to provide maximum value from data in all shapes and sizes (such as classification models, NLP, anomaly detection, graph theory, deep learning, and more). As a Data Scientist, you will assume the classic data-science role of an end-to-end project development and implementation practitioner. Being part of the team requires a mix of hard quantitative and analytical skills, solid background in statistical modeling and machine learning, a technical data-savvy nature, along with a passion for problem-solving and a desire to drive data-driven decision-making.


 

What You'll Be Doing
Data Exploration and Preprocessing: Collect, clean, and transform large, complex data sets from various sources to ensure data quality and integrity for analysis
Statistical Analysis and Modeling: Apply statistical methods and mathematical models to identify patterns, trends, and relationships in data sets, and develop predictive models
Machine Learning: Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, such as classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning, to solve business problems and improve processes
Feature Engineering: Extract relevant features from structured and unstructured data sources, and design and engineer new features to enhance model performance
Model Development and Evaluation: Build, train, and optimize machine learning models using state-of-the-art techniques, and evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics
Data Visualization: Present complex analysis results in a clear and concise manner using data visualization techniques, and communicate insights to stakeholders effectively
Collaborative Problem-Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders to identify data-driven solutions and implement them in production environments
Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and related fields, and proactively explore new approaches to enhance the company's analytical capabilities

 

Qualifications
B.Sc (M.Sc is a plus) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
3+ years of proven experience designing and implementing machine learning algorithms and successfully deploying them to production.
Strong understanding and practical experience with various machine learning algorithms.
Proficiency in Python, Experience with SQL and data manipulation tools (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) to extract, clean, and transform data for analysis
Solid foundation in statistical concepts and techniques, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, and experimental design
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach business problems, formulate hypotheses, and translate them into actionable solutions
Proficiency in data visualization libraries, to create meaningful visual representations of complex data
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present complex findings and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to a positive work environment
Advantages:
Experience in the fraud domain
Experience with Airflow, CircleCI, PySpark, Docker and K8S

We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.

The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.

Life at Riskified

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.

We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.

Hybrid mode of work

Healthcare benefits

Benefits package per month—per your choice, e.g., work-from-home equipment, gym membership, wellbeing activities, and more.
